integrity: Analytical proof includes exact conditional arcsine reduction, elliptic evaluations, and uniform asymptotic expansion away from caustic centers; deterministic checks supplement rather than replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Only equal unit circles in specified perpendicular planes, with center offset along one plane normal; independent arclength-uniform points; not universal for arbitrary relative orientations. Priority is not independently certified.
title: Elliptic distance laws and merging logarithmic caustics for perpendicular circular wires
